name: Broad Meadow Brook Nature Camp
description_short: Mass Audubon day camp at Broad Meadow Brook Wildlife Sanctuary in Worcester for ages 4.5–16, with most of the day spent outdoors hiking, exploring habitats and doing nature projects. Options include a three-day mini camp, weekly camp by age group, a specialty field-trip week, and a Counselor-in-Training program.

source.title: Broad Meadow Brook Nature Camp Programs & Pricing

warnings: The page shows the 2026 season, which has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 dates, prices or registration date are posted yet.

All prices are sliding-scale ranges, not single prices: Mini Camp $42–$210, One-week Nature Camp $94–$470, Exploring Mass Audubon $104–$518, CIT training $94–$470, Before Camp $10–$50/week, After Camp $15–$75/week. Families registering at Tiers 4 or 5 must have an active family-level or higher Mass Audubon membership. Session prices and price_per_week are left blank because there is no single rate.
Bear Cubs and Before Camp start at age 4.5. Ages here are whole numbers, so age_min is recorded as 4.

The weekly sessions are split by age group: Grasshoppers 5–6, Flickers 7–8, Mighty Oaks 9–11, Coyotes 12–15. Each age group is booked separately. Individual weeks were worked out from 'Weekly sessions: June 22- August 28'.
Week 2 (June 29–July 3) includes the July 3 Independence Day observed holiday. The page does not say whether that week is shorter or costs less.
The only street address on the page is Mass Audubon headquarters in Lincoln, MA, not the camp, so it was not recorded.
